opus.problem: Clue 5 repeats the same fact as clue 4. Both come from Ezekiel 1:28 and both say the brilliant light or glory around the LORD looked like this. They are not two different facts. Replace one with a different fact.

Clue 1 gives the word away on its own. 'Set in the clouds as a sign that no flood would destroy the earth again' after Noah left the ark is the best-known description of the rainbow, so it is not medium hard.
